name: Drawing extras
description: Example of the drawing extras of the component format: radial and angular gradients in a node's fill, next to the linear one, a gradient chosen by a $switch, the inner shadow of a node's shadow, and images of the library package in an image node's src. The Gradients component draws four swatches that read their two colors from fields; the Inner shadow component draws a sunken field and two buttons; the Logo component draws three package images (PNG, JPEG and WebP from the images folder): a fixed one, one chosen by a $switch and one named by a field.

annotationTypes.name: Gradients
annotationTypes.description: Swatches of a radial, an angular and a linear gradient, and a main swatch whose gradient type follows the kind field.

fields.label: Kind
fields.description: The gradient type of the main swatch: radial, angular or linear.

fields.label: From
fields.description: The first color of every gradient.

fields.label: To
fields.description: The last color of every gradient; it continues beyond the radius of the radial one.

annotationTypes.name: Inner shadow
annotationTypes.description: A sunken text field, a raised button and a pressed button: the inner shadow (CSS inset) of a rect, alone and in a list.

fields.label: Text
fields.description: The text inside the sunken field.

fields.label: Accent
fields.description: The color of the raised and the pressed button.

annotationTypes.name: Logo
annotationTypes.description: Three images of the package: a fixed logo, an image chosen by the variant field and an image whose package path is the source field.

fields.label: Variant
fields.description: The image of the middle slot, chosen by a $switch: png, jpeg or webp.

fields.label: Source
fields.description: A package image path (images/logo.png, images/photo.jpg or images/pattern.webp) drawn in the last slot.
